title: Relationship
description: A typed, directional connection between any two entities. Relationships allow the evidence model to express who knew whom, which organisations were connected, which events triggered other events, and similar structural connections.

id.description: Stable entity identifier in format boe:relationship:<ulid>. Constant across versions.

from_id.description: The source entity of this relationship.

from_type.description: The type of the source entity.

to_id.description: The target entity of this relationship.

to_type.description: The type of the target entity.

relationship_type.description: The nature of the relationship. Use descriptive past-tense verbs: 'directed', 'employed', 'reported_to', 'participated_in', 'contradicts', 'corroborates', 'preceded', 'triggered', 'funded', 'communicated_with'.

description.description: Human-readable description of this specific relationship and its significance.

period.description: When this relationship existed or was active.

claim_id.description: For contestable relationships (participation, responsibility, undisclosed connections), the Claim entity that asserts this relationship and carries its evidence and assessment. Uncontested public-record relationships (e.g., a senator chaired a committee) may omit this.

confidence_level.description: Confidence that this relationship exists as described. For contestable relationships this must mirror the assessment of the backing claim referenced in claim_id.

source_ids.description: Sources that document or support this relationship.
